name: Eric Schmitt
bio: Eric Stephen Schmitt is an American attorney and Republican Party politician serving since 2023 as the junior United States senator from Missouri. Schmitt served as the 46th state treasurer of Missouri from 2017 to 2019 and as the 43rd Missouri attorney general from 2019 to 2023.

voteHistory.billTitle: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Public Land Order No. 7917 for Withdrawal of Federal Lands; Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties, MN.
